parameters.content:
## Actual calls require an enabled transport
The app checks consent, test-number allowlist, per-day limits and zero-spend budget, then calls the configured provider or user-owned SIM bridge. Four Hindi/English questions and signed answer callbacks are handled by the app/provider adapter. n8n success is acceptance, not proof the senior answered. This workflow is inactive until configured and tested; no carrier account or free calling allowance is included in n8n AI Builder credits.
